description:
Jot it down the moment it comes to you. Grow it later, right on your device.

Otanecho is an idea notebook built around one second of capture. There is no save button. Tap +, start typing, and it is already saved as a seed.

CAPTURE FROM ANYWHERE
• Action Button, Control Center, Lock Screen and Home Screen widgets, the share sheet, Siri, or your voice. Every route goes straight to the input screen.
• No folder to pick, no fields to fill in. Write, then walk away.

AI THAT STAYS OUT OF THE WAY
• A title and tags are added for you right after you save.
• Open a seed and the related ones surface next to it.
• Nothing rewrites what you wrote. The words stay yours.

GROW WHAT YOU WROTE
• Tap Grow and answer the questions you are asked. "Is this assumption true?" "Who struggles with this most?"
• A seed sprouts, and then becomes a tree. Three answers and it is a tree.

LOOK BACK ONCE A WEEK
• The weekly review brings back the seeds you forgot and suggests pairings you would not have thought of.

PRIVATE FROM THE START
• The AI runs on your device with Apple Intelligence. What you write is not sent anywhere to be processed.
• It works without the AI too. On a device that cannot run it, the AI parts quietly disappear.

Requires iOS 26. The AI features need a device that supports Apple Intelligence.
